item.title: Sermon Cut 1.3.30
item.description:
• The sermon no longer starts in the middle of the baptisms. Sunday's Wilmington recording was cut at 12:37 when the preaching began at 25:52: the testimonies ran for fifteen minutes without a long enough break, so the detector's working block opened eighteen minutes early and every trim that should have pulled it back gave up. A block now starts where its longest unbroken run of talking starts, when a minute and a half with nobody talking separates that run from whatever came first. On that recording it now lands nine seconds before the sermon, the same as every other Sunday; the ten Wilmington recordings before it come out unchanged.
  • A paired recorder no longer hides every other source. The drives appear as soon as they are read and the recorder's clips are folded in when they arrive, instead of everything waiting behind the deck — and after 45 seconds the scan goes on without it.
